nodes.label: Shared-Code-Only Policy
nodes.rationale: Only code needed by both ClearRead and SoundSight belongs here; app-specific prompts, detection logic and content stay in app repos.

nodes.label: Prefer Functions and Closures
nodes.rationale: Classes only for settings and required third-party interfaces.

nodes.label: Independent py-vX.Y.Z / web-vX.Y.Z Tags
nodes.rationale: Packages released independently after consuming-app integration validation; snapshot vX.Y.Z releases do not prove integration.

nodes.label: Empty __init__.py Policy
nodes.rationale: Import APIs from named modules rather than package re-exports.

nodes.label: Every Security Fix Needs Regression Test
Latest Stable Python 3 Policy
nodes.rationale: CI uses 3.x with check-latest; metadata declares minimum version, not a pin.

nodes.label: Shared Web UI Demo (npm run demo)
access_kit.safe_fetch.fetcher
nodes.rationale: Validates every DNS answer, connects to validated IP preserving SNI/Host, revalidates redirects, refuses HTTPS downgrades and proxies.

nodes.label: Connect-Time IP Pinning
nodes.rationale: Defeats DNS rebinding: the IP that passed validation is the one connected to.

nodes.label: scripts/scan_secrets.py history allowlist
nodes.rationale: Recognizes exactly two fake URI fixtures in immutable commits; history not rewritten.

nodes.label: 100% coverage for fetching, sessions, privacy, log scrubbing
nodes.rationale: Coverage establishes regression coverage but does not replace security review.

nodes.label: Phase B: Python v0.1
nodes.rationale: Library complete; accepted only after ClearRead installs py-v0.1.0 and runs Phase 1 pipeline.

nodes.label: Phase C: Web v0.1
nodes.rationale: Acceptance requires SoundSight first screen and ClearRead reader consuming the same package.

Consuming-App Integration Acceptance
nodes.rationale: Release acceptance requires integration in consuming apps, not only this repo's tests.

nodes.label: access-kit v0.1 Python Core Design Spec
Zero-Classes Constraint (py-no-classes check)
nodes.rationale: Code style forbids classes except BaseSettings and third-party interfaces; stateful ops use closures and functools.partial.

nodes.label: AccessKitSettings (BaseSettings)
nodes.rationale: Pydantic class unavoidable for env validation (carve-out).

nodes.label: make_fetcher (closure-based safe_fetch)
nodes.rationale: Replaces planned SafeFetcher class; returns (fetch, download) closing over config.

nodes.label: LLMProvider TypedDict (dict of closures)
nodes.rationale: TypedDict instead of Protocol to avoid failing the no-classes check.

nodes.label: Coverage targets: 85% overall, 100% safe_fetch
nodes.rationale: safe_fetch is security-critical.

nodes.label: health_router with pluggable async checks
nodes.rationale: Checks run concurrently; any failure/timeout yields 503; no exception messages leaked.

nodes.label: request_id_middleware / setup_logging
nodes.rationale: Default JSON handler drops bodies, headers, URLs, IPs, exception text.

nodes.label: client_ip / hash_ip (HMAC-SHA256)
nodes.rationale: Cloudflare headers require trust_cloudflare and trusted_proxies; app owns retention.

nodes.label: session_middleware / get_session_id / rotate_session
nodes.rationale: Stateless rotation does not revoke old cookies; not authentication or CSRF protection.

nodes.label: with_fallback / LLMFallbackError
nodes.rationale: Fallback is opt-in; usage accumulates across failed attempts.

nodes.label: Settings store (getSettingsStore/createSettingsStore)
nodes.rationale: Storage key access-kit:settings:v1; falls back to in-memory on storage failure, persisted=false.

nodes.label: Five themes (light, dark, sepia, contrast, calm) + system
Local fonts (Atkinson Hyperlegible, Noto Sans)
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted to avoid third-party font services; not a medical-benefit claim.

nodes.label: vibrate() opt-in haptics
nodes.rationale: Does not silently enable from preferences; explicit opt-in required.

nodes.label: Playwright + axe browser checks
nodes.rationale: Automated checks do not replace screen reader or user testing.

nodes.label: access-kit Demo Page (A little more comfortable)
Access-Kit v0.1 Python Core Implementation Plan
Zero Classes Constraint
nodes.rationale: Only Exception, NamedTuple, TypedDict and pydantic BaseSettings allowed; everything else is closures and plain functions.

nodes.label: Latest Stable Python 3 Policy
nodes.rationale: Fixed-version examples superseded by CI 3.x with check-latest: true.

nodes.label: jscpd Zero-Tolerance Duplicate Check
nodes.rationale: Drives extraction of complete_json_with_retry so providers do not duplicate retry logic.

nodes.label: SSRF Validation at Every Redirect Hop
nodes.rationale: Each redirect target IP is re-resolved and validated before connecting; redirects followed manually.

nodes.label: DNS Rebinding Defense via IP Pinning
nodes.rationale: No custom transport class; httpx with rewritten IP URL, Host header and sni_hostname extension.

nodes.label: Tox Envs py-test / py-typecheck / py-no-classes
nodes.rationale: Defined early, added to env_list only in Task 15.

nodes.label: AccessKitSettings
nodes.rationale: pydantic-settings BaseSettings; missing public_base_url, redis_url, session_secret raises ValidationError at startup.

nodes.label: get_session_id
nodes.rationale: Constant-time HMAC compare; tampered cookie returns None rather than raising.

nodes.label: HMAC-Signed Stateless Session Cookie (ak_sid)
nodes.rationale: Session state in cookies, HMAC-signed without itsdangerous.

nodes.label: is_blocked_ip
nodes.rationale: Fails closed: malformed input (octal/hex/decimal) is blocked; IPv4-mapped IPv6 unwrapped.

nodes.label: Safe Fetch Exceptions (BlockedDestination, TooLarge, BadContentType, TooManyRedirects, FetchTimeout)
make_fetcher
nodes.rationale: Returns (fetch, download) closures; download is non-streaming (shortcut: switch to client.stream() if memory pressure).

nodes.label: LLMProvider TypedDict
nodes.rationale: Provider as dict of closures instead of a class.

nodes.label: complete_json_with_retry
nodes.rationale: Shared across providers to satisfy jscpd; raises LLMValidationError after max_retries.

nodes.label: Subagent-Driven Execution Recommendation
nodes.rationale: 15 mostly independent tasks; per-task review catches errors before propagation in a security-critical library.
